description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open-source test management tool. It processes requirement search queries, constructs SQL statements for complex searches involving requirements, revisions, versions, and related entities, and generates HTML tables for displaying search results. The file includes external dependencies, manages user input, and generates dynamic content based on search criteria.

methods.name: buildExtTable
methods.description: Constructs an HTML table to display requirement search results with grouping, sorting, and interactive links.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes search parameters from HTTP request variables, sanitizes and converts dates for database queries.

methods.name: build_search_sql
methods.description: Builds a complex SQL query for searching requirements, versions, revisions, and related entities based on user-specified criteria.
